title: Umwizera witwikiriye mu rugo rw'umunyagitugu
intro: Mu nzu z’izahabu z’umutegetsi w’umwirasi uzwi muri Korowani — aho kutumvira Imana byasobanuraga buri tegeko — umuntu umwe yagendaga mu bantu bafite amahirwe menshi, ahisha amabanga ateye akaga cyane mu maso ye. Uyu muntu yari afite ukwemera kwari kubujijwe muri izo nkuta ku buryo kukubona byasobanuraga urupfu rudashidikanywaho. Nyamara kwemera icyaha kwarakongotse nk’umuriro munsi y’ivu, kandi igihe kigeze, ukuri kwaranguruye ubutwari bwahungabanyije urufatiro rw’ingoro y’umunyagitugu.
clues: Nabaye mu muryango w’umutegetsi ukomeye kandi wishyira hejuru kurusha abandi bose bo mu gihe cyanjye, nkikijwe n’ibintu byiza n’ububasha.
Nahishe ukwemera kwanjye nyakuri mu mutima wanjye, ntinya ko abategekaga ubugome n'igitugu bazapfa.
Ubwo abantu banjye bashidikanyaga kandi bagashidikanya ku kuri, nagiye imbere kugira ngo mbaburire ku byago bikomeye byagwiririye amahanga ya kera yanze intumwa z'Umwami wabo.
Nibukije abantu banjye inkuru y'umusore w'inzozi wakundwaga cyane wajugunywe hasi n'abavandimwe be ariko akaza ku mwanya w'ubuyobozi bukomeye mu gihugu cya kure.
Nasabye abaturage banjye kutumvira umutegetsi wabayobeje, ahubwo ndabasaba kunkurikira mu nzira yo gukiranuka no kuyobora.
Navuze ukuri ku mugaragaro nubwo abayoboke b'uwo mugome banteye ubwoba ko bazanyicisha amabuye cyangwa banyirukana mu gihugu.
